100.title: Rock Paper Scissors
100.adminInfo: Players play best two out of three

200.title: Paper Airplane
200.adminInfo: Players make paper airplanes and whoever's toss goes the farthest wins. 1 minute to make

300.title: Ping Pong Battle
300.adminInfo: Players play a game to 3, selecting team serves

400.title: Big Bluff
400.adminInfo: Two players on the selecting team are given a red card and black card. One member from the other team can ask them who has the red card and they have to pick the right person. 60 seconds

500.title: Reverse Charades
500.adminInfo: Both teams play reverse charades for 1 minute, most points wins

101.title: Impressions
101.adminInfo:
Players will do impressions of the following lines.
1. Australian: Crikey, mate, that kangaroo’s got some serious hops, eh?
2. Italian: Bella, you’ve got to try this gelato, it’s like heaven in a cone!
3. Scottish: This’ll be a grand day for a wee bit of adventure, eh?

201.title: Spikeball
201.adminInfo: Players play a game to 3, selecting team serves

301.title: Art Contest
301.adminInfo: Players draw the following prompt and have two minutes: Marty feeding the ducks at his duck pond

501.title: Catch Phrase
501.adminInfo: Teams play a round of catch phrase, whoever gets the most in one minute wins
